title: Nampa Valley Helicopters

services.name: Nampa Valley Helicopters
services.desc: Based in Meridian, Idaho, Nampa Valley Helicopters is an Airbus Helicopters “D Level” Service Center specializing in the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) of Airbus Helicopters Dynamic Components for the AS350 H125, AS355, EC130 H130 and EC135 H135 series

blurb: Nampa Valley Helicopters provides certified excellence in dynamic component repair and overhaul for Airbus and Bell helicopter models. They also offer full aircraft maintenance, avionics installation, and field support. Their team is committed to safety, performance, and quality workmanship.
